ohtani.title: Ozzie Albies hits go-ahead single in Braves' 4-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Ozzie Albies drives in the go-ahead run and Raisel Iglesias locks down the save to seal the Braves' 4-3 victory over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Craig Counsell recaps the Cubs' 19-2 win
imanaga.blurb: Craig Counsell talks about the Cubs drawing nine walks, Aaron Civale's performance out of the bullpen and more following the Cubs' 19-2 win

suzuki.title: Waldschmidt's walk-off homer leads D-backs to a win
suzuki.blurb: Ryan Waldschmidt crushes a walk-off two-run home run to lead the D-backs to a 5-4 comeback win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Lugo's outing leads Royals to ninth-straight win
okamoto.blurb: Seth Lugo tosses five stellar innings and Salvador Perez hits an RBI single to lead the Royals to a 5-3 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Six-run 1st powers White Sox to 11-7 win
murakami.blurb: Tristan Peters' three RBIs paces the White Sox offense in their 11-7 victory over the Rangers

matsui.title: Nick Gonzales comes through in Pirates' win
matsui.blurb: Nick Gonzales provides the go-ahead hit and Braxton Ashcraft tosses six solid innings in the Pirates' 3-2 extra-inning win over the Padres
